text: I'd say Nauryz, which we celebrate in March to mark the start of spring and the new year. It lasts several days, and people visit relatives, cook Nauryz kozhe, a special soup made from seven ingredients, and there are concerts and yurts set up in the city squares.

tips.en: The name, date and meaning are all in the first sentence.
tips.kk: Мерекенің атауы, күні және мәні — бірінші сөйлемде.
tips.ru: Название, дата и смысл праздника — в первой фразе.
tips.example: to mark the start of spring and the new year

tips.en: The local word is explained at once, so the examiner understands.
tips.kk: Жергілікті сөз бірден түсіндіріледі — емтихан алушыға бәрі түсінікті.
tips.ru: Местное слово сразу поясняется — экзаменатору всё понятно.
tips.example: a special soup made from seven ingredients

note.en: “To celebrate or show the importance of”.

questions.question: What is the most important public holiday in your country?

text: That mostly comes down to how long the break is. If it's just one day off, I tend to have a lie-in and meet friends in the evening. But when we get a long weekend, my family usually drives out to the mountains for a picnic or goes to see my grandparents in the village.

tips.en: A short and a long break lead to different plans, so the answer is developed.
tips.kk: Қысқа және ұзақ демалыс — әртүрлі жоспар, жауап толық.
tips.ru: Короткий и длинный выходной — разные планы, ответ развёрнут.
tips.example: But when we get a long weekend

tips.en: Tend to and usually sound more natural than always.
tips.kk: Tend to және usually always сөзінен табиғирақ естіледі.
tips.ru: Tend to и usually звучат естественнее, чем always.
tips.example: I tend to have a lie-in

note.en: “Stay in bed late in the morning”.

questions.followUp: Do you stay at home or go somewhere?
questions.question: How do you usually spend public holidays?

text: Yes, I think so, because as a child you don't have to organise anything — you just enjoy it. What I remember most is New Year at my grandmother's house, with the whole family squeezed around one table and all the cousins staying up until well after midnight.

tips.en: General you explains the point without repeating I.
tips.kk: Жалпы мағынадағы you «мен, мен» деп қайталамай түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: You в общем значении объясняет без «я, я, я».

title.en: A reason as a general truth

tips.example: as a child you don't have to organise anything

tips.en: A specific scene — the table, the cousins, midnight — instead of general words.
tips.kk: Жалпы сөз орнына нақты көрініс — дастархан, немере бауырлар, түн ортасы.
tips.ru: Конкретная сцена — стол, кузены, полночь — вместо общих слов.
tips.example: with the whole family squeezed around one table

questions.question: Did you enjoy holidays more as a child?

text: For big traditional holidays, it has to be family — it wouldn't feel right otherwise. But for something like my birthday, I'd much rather go out with a few close friends, because we can be a bit sillier and nobody asks me when I'm going to get married.

tips.en: Family for traditions, friends for birthdays — both with a reason.
tips.kk: Отбасы — дәстүрлі мерекеге, достар — туған күнге: екеуі де себебімен.
tips.ru: Семья — для традиций, друзья — для дня рождения: оба варианта с причиной.
tips.example: For big traditional holidays, it has to be family

tips.en: The joke about the marriage question sounds natural and shows fluency.
tips.kk: Үйлену туралы сұрақ жайлы әзіл табиғи естіледі, еркін сөйлеуді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Шутка про вопрос о свадьбе звучит естественно и показывает беглость.
tips.example: nobody asks me when I'm going to get married

questions.question: Do you prefer celebrating with family or with friends?

text: Honestly, I think we have about the right number already. More days off sound great in theory, but in practice work just piles up and everyone has to stay late before and after the break. What I'd prefer is being able to choose a few days off myself.

tips.en: A reasoned “no” sounds more convincing than an obvious “yes”.
tips.kk: Түсіндірмесі бар «жоқ» айқын «иә» дегеннен сенімдірек естіледі.
tips.example: I think we have about the right number already

tips.en: In theory … in practice is a strong pair for contrast.
tips.kk: In theory … in practice — қарама-қарсы қоюға күшті жұп.
tips.ru: In theory … in practice — сильная пара для контраста.

note.en: A structure that puts the focus on the preference.

questions.question: Would you like to have more public holidays?
